title: Credit Bureau Reporting Settings by Stage for Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Credit Reporting team schedule for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. It records, per placement stage, whether Ridgeline furnishes a collection tradeline at all and the waits, file dates and service times used in furnishing.

| Stage | Tradeline furnished at the stage | Wait after the validation notice before an initial report (calendar days) | Monthly file day of the month | Dispute flag added within (business days after the dispute) | Paid status update within (calendar days after paid or settled) | Tradeline deletion within (business days after the triggering event) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | No | 0 | 5 | 2 | 30 | 5 |
| Primary Placement | Yes | 35 | 5 | 2 | 30 | 5 |
| Secondary Placement | Yes | 35 | 5 | 2 | 30 | 5 |
| Tertiary Placement | Yes | 35 | 5 | 2 | 30 | 5 |
| Warehouse Placement | Yes | 45 | 5 | 2 | 30 | 10 |
| Legal Review Placement | Yes | 35 | 5 | 2 | 30 | 5 |

## Definitions

- **Tradeline furnished at the stage**: whether Ridgeline furnishes a collection tradeline at that stage.
- **Wait after the validation notice**: the calendar days after the validation notice is sent before an initial tradeline may be furnished.
- **Monthly file day**: the day of the month on which the monthly tradeline file is furnished.
- **Dispute flag time**: the business days after a dispute within which a live tradeline is flagged as disputed.
- **Paid status update time**: the calendar days after an account is paid or settled within which the tradeline status update is furnished.
- **Deletion time**: the business days after the triggering event within which a tradeline deletion is furnished.

## Reading the schedule

- Early-Out Placement furnishes no tradeline; its wait figure of 0 days therefore never comes into use.
- Warehouse Placement differs from the other reporting stages in two columns: a 45-day wait after the notice and a 10-business-day deletion time.
- The monthly file goes on the 5th of the month, and the dispute flag and paid status update times are the same, at every stage.
